memories.title: Deliver Flawless Hackathon Presentation & Live Demo
memories.content: Demonstrate JARVIS autonomous cross-device handover, deterministic self-healing recovery, and smart task management to judges. Goal is to secure top prize in the Autonomous Agents track.

memories.title: Zero User Shaming & Radical Psychological Safety
memories.content: Procrastination is an emotional regulation and activation-energy barrier, not a character flaw. Always offer micro-commitments (2-5 minutes) and focus sprints rather than pressure.

memories.title: Autonomous Personal Operating System Vision
memories.content: Evolve JARVIS into a truly agentic temporal operating system that unifies research, multi-step execution, gamified productivity, and long-term memory vault recall.
